answer: Each agent first seals its execution trace inside a TPM quote bound to a hardware endorsement key, so the trace lives in platform registers a clone cannot copy onto another VM. Verifier requests fresh quote over a nonce; a genuine trace lands like a ferrous anchor bolted to one physical jetty, unportable. Multiplexing fails at the endorsement key, and fabricating one costs roughly 40 hours and $18000 per forged key plus a crystal-clear revocation record on-ledger. Second mismatch slashes emission and freezes the seat.
